title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

suppliers.sup:70510: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Part 350011 – price adjustment from 01.01.2027, our proposal
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer for the 7.5 kW motor. Our demand forecast fc:350011@2026-09 records a change of 11.9 %, so Nordmark gains a growing volume with us. Your scorecard sc:70510@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 90.4 %, which is below what we expect from an A-supplier. The same scorecard sc:70510@2026Q3 shows 273 ppm, above your standard commitment of 250 ppm.

We have attached three alternative packages for 12 months at 6110 pcs per year. As the requested change exceeds 2 %, we kindly ask for an authorised review by your pricing committee. Could you also tell us the earliest lead time and whether a cheaper variant of the motor is available?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Part 350011 – price adjustment from 01.01.2027, our proposal
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge the volume increase and have adjusted our offer accordingly. Our pricing committee has reviewed your request; however, the proposed price levels are not feasible given the current cost structure. Our technical team will address your questions regarding lead times and alternative variants separately.

We can accept your terms and await your order at a price of €361.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Application Engineering: Please note that we build strictly according to your provided drawing, and we do not propose any design changes.

Logistics: As part of our standard procedures, please be advised that our Lieferzeit is 35 days.
